comment: Build-time self-checks for the compiled engine. compile_engine.py passes each entry to aerie_adblock_compile as --expect-block or --expect-allow, and the tool fails the build if the real EasyList and EasyPrivacy do not agree. They guard against an empty, truncated or wrongly parsed list. Fields: url, hostname, source_hostname, type, third_party. Pick long-lived rules only: well known ad and tracker hosts. Update with the filter list lock (docs/adblock.md).
